toolInput.prompt:
Active task: .trellis/tasks/10-26-textstats-top

You are already the trellis-check sub-agent. Review and fix directly. Do not spawn another trellis-check or trellis-implement.

Do not commit. Do not push. Do not run git commit, git push, or git merge. Do not archive the task. Do not revert the task.json status flip to in_progress; that came from task.py start.

Load context yourself first:
1. Read .trellis/tasks/10-26-textstats-top/check.jsonl and every file it lists (GLOSSARY.md, docs/adr/0001-rank-exact-words.md).
2. Read .trellis/tasks/10-26-textstats-top/prd.md. There is no design.md and no implement.md.
3. Run python3 ./.trellis/scripts/get_context.py --mode packages and read each relevant spec index Quality Check section plus .trellis/spec/guides/index.md. Specs may still be bootstrap placeholders.
4. Review git diff for textstats.py and tests/test_textstats.py against the PRD.

The PRD acceptance contract:
- No arguments: same words:/lines: summary, exit 0.
- Sole --help: exact usage on stdout, exit 0, stdin not read.
- --top plus one token matching [1-9][0-9]*: summary, then ranking, no blank line, no header, exit 0.
- Ranking line is `<word> <frequency>` with one space and a newline.
- Fewer than N distinct Words: print all and exit 0. No Words: zero summary and no ranking lines.
- Any other invocation: exact usage on stderr, empty stdout, exit 2, stdin not read. Includes missing value, 0, negative, leading + or 0, non-integer, --top=N, filename, short flag, and --help mixed with anything else.
- Usage line exactly: Usage: textstats [--top N]  # read stdin, print word and line counts; with --top N also print the N most frequent words\n
- Golden: stdin `A a A cat, cat cat,` and --top 3 → words: 6\nlines: 1\nA 2\ncat, 2\na 1\n
- Word = maximal non-whitespace sequence. Rank by frequency descending, then ascending Unicode code point. lines: meaning unchanged.

Fix any defect you find in the product code or tests. Then run:
python3 -m unittest tests.test_textstats -v

There is no project lint or type-check config. Do not invent one.

Report what you reviewed, any fixes, and the test result. A check you did not run is not a pass.
